// diagnostic

E3506

The link or post-link step `{hook}` that {setting} names failed on `{output}`.

What

The link or post-link step `{hook}` that {setting} names failed on `{output}`.

Why

The `link` build option names a hook, a function marked `#On(build.link)`, that `jet build` calls on each executable's link inputs, and `post_link` the hooks marked `#On(build.before_write)` that turn the linked file into the one written, in order. Jet runs the `BuildAction` each hook returns in the build sandbox, or links in process when a link action runs no command, and never falls back to another link or skips a step, so the executable is the steps' or none.

Fix

Fix the hook or the command its step runs, whose output follows, write `link: default` to link with Jet, or drop the step from `post_link`.
